explanations.duplicate_table: Table "{table}" already exists in the database. You cannot create a table with the same name unless you drop the old one or use IF NOT EXISTS.
explanations.undefined_table: Table "{table}" has not been created or the name is misspelled. Check your CREATE TABLE statement or execution order.
explanations.undefined_column: Column "{column}" does not exist in the table. Check the column spelling or CREATE TABLE definition.

explanations.syntax_error: SQL syntax is invalid at or near "{token}". Check your commas, closing parentheses, or keywords.

explanations.invalid_text_representation: Value "{value}" cannot be converted into data type "{type}".

explanations.data_too_long: The value inserted into column "{column}" exceeds the defined column length (e.g. VARCHAR overflow). Shorten the data or expand the column definition.
